title: Testing Your Stakes Sentence
use_cases: Use when evaluating the clarity and impact of a querying stake
Implement when testing if a narrative conflict is strong enough to sustain a novel
Configure when auditing a query letter for external readability under time constraints
Use when deciding whether to perform additional revisions on a submission pitch
content:
Ask yourself these questions:

Is it specific? Can someone who hasn’t read your book understand exactly what’s at risk, even if they’re reading at inbox speed?

Is it compelling? Would you want to read this book based on this choice?

Is it clear? Is there any confusion about what the character must decide?

Does it show enough tension? Will this decision carry a full novel?

If you can answer yes to all four, you’ve done it! If you haven’t–you’ll have to decide if saving the extra editing time is worth the risk of a higher rejection rate (see what we did there? You are, in fact, the main character of your querying journey).
